verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official SDK, in any language, for building against Grok Build. The closest items are adjacent: headless mode, running Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC, structured output formats, and an OpenAPI spec for the xAI API. These are protocols and building blocks, not first-party SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
